# Trip Malabar

> > Trip Malabar specializes in sustainable cultural heritage and adventure tourism experiences in North Kerala, featuring Kasaragod, Kannur, Theyyam rituals, and Western Ghats exploration.

Trip Malabar Travels curates authentic travel experiences in the Malabar region of North Kerala, focusing on heritage sites, traditional art forms like Theyyam, eco-tourism in the Western Ghats, and immersive cultural tours. The company emphasizes sustainable tourism practices while showcasing the diverse religious heritage, cuisine, and natural beauty of Kasaragod and surrounding districts.

## Key Topics

- Kasaragod
- North Kerala
- Theyyam ritual dance
- Western Ghats
- Malabar cultural heritage
- Kerala temples
- Kannur
- Bekal Fort
- Arabian Sea maritime history
- Ananthapura Lake Temple
- Ranipuram trekking
- Kerala tourism
- Adventure travel
- Sustainable tourism
- Mappila culture

## Tour Packages & Services

- [Best Holiday Trip in North Kerala | Trip Malabar](https://www.tripmalabar.com): Homepage for TripMalabar Travels specializing in North Kerala experiences
- [Best Of Kasaragod | Tripmalabar Travels](https://www.tripmalabar.com/kasaragod-holiday-package-3n-4d): 3N/4D Kasaragod heritage package with Thalathoor Homestay & cultural tours
- [Arts & Crafts Tour North Kerala | TripMalabar](https://www.tripmalabar.com/north-kerala-arts-craft-holiday): 4-day cultural heritage tour: Theyyam, bell metal art in Kannur-Kasaragod
- [About us | Trip Malabar](https://www.tripmalabar.com/about-us): TripMalabar Travels company story: sustainable North Kerala tourism experts

## Cultural Heritage & Traditions

- [Theyyam: The Dancing Gods of North Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/theyyam-the-dance-of-gods): North Malabar's ritual Theyyam dance tradition & tribal religious art form
- [Kasaragod Saree Weaving Center](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/kasaragod-saree-weaving-center): GI-tagged Kasaragod handloom saree weaving center & artisan community
- [Islam in Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/islam-in-kerala): Mappila culture & Indo-Arab trade heritage on Malabar coast
- [Hindus of Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/hindus-of-kerala): Kerala Hindu history, temple traditions, Onam festival & mythology

## Temples & Spiritual Sites

- [Ananthapura Lake Temple:  Only Lake Temple Of Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/ananthapura-lake-temple-only-lake-temple-of-kerala): Kerala's unique lake temple dedicated to Lord Vishnu in Kasaragod
- [Malik Dinar Mosque](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/malik-dinar-mosque): Historic Malik Deenar Juma Masjid in Thalangara, Kasaragod heritage site
- [Ashrams of Malabar](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/ashrams-of-malabar): Spiritual tourism guide to Anand Ashram & NityaNanda Ashram in Kasaragod

## Adventure & Nature Tourism

- [Ranipuram - Best Trek of North Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/ranipuram-best-trek-of-north-kerala): Trekking guide to Ranipuram in Western Ghats, Kasaragod district
- [Houseboat in North Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/houseboat-in-north-kerala): Kettuvallam houseboat cruises in Valiyaparamba & Kavvayi Backwaters

## Kerala History & Geography

- [The Araian Sea: A Pivotal Factor in Kerala's History](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/the-araian-sea-a-pivotal-factor-in-kerala-s-history): Arabian Sea's role in Kerala's maritime trade & cultural exchange history
- [Discover the Rich History of Mountain Passes in Kerala](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/discover-the-rich-history-of-mountain-passes-in-kerala): Historical trade routes through Western Ghats including Palakkad Gap

## Food & Cuisine

- [Kasaragod - A Foodie's Paradise](https://www.tripmalabar.com/post/kasaragod-a-foodie-s-paradise): Kasaragod food guide featuring Malabar cuisine & local restaurants
